title: Navigation and dealer guidance
summary: This topic mixes in-car turn-by-turn or backup guidance comments with praise for staff or dealer guidance, so the examples do not form a single coherent issue.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise clear turn-by-turn navigation in difficult intersections and helpful guidance from dealers or staff.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention redirected turn-by-turn navigation, BMW Genius or manager guidance, and backup guidance without enough context to assign clear sentiment consistently.

limitations: The topic cluster mixes unrelated subjects, including vehicle navigation features and human guidance from dealer or support staff.
Several examples are undetermined, so the sample gives limited evidence about whether some mentions are praise, complaints, or simple descriptions.
These sampled fragments are stratified examples and are not representative estimates of the broader population of reviews.
